name: Holding Your Peace
overview: Scripture calls believers to maintain peace through active love, forgiveness, and self-control. Holding your peace involves rebuking with the goal of repentance and extending forgiveness when it is granted, as taught in Luke 17:3. This peace is rooted in walking by the Spirit to overcome fleshly desires, putting away bitterness and anger, and embodying the love Christ commanded in John 13:34. Furthermore, supporting the weak and living by the law of liberty through gracious speech and deeds reflect the blessedness of giving rather than receiving, fostering unity and peace within the body of Christ.
